title: Texting and WeChat
focus: Written chat language: 好的 没事 怎么 什么 为什么 哈哈 谢谢 不客气 等一下 马上 到了 吗 呢 吧 啊.
body:
# Texting and WeChat

Chat Chinese is written the way people talk, so you already know every word here. What's new is seeing them typed: the particles (吗 呢 吧 啊), the set replies (好的, 收到, 没事), and the little tone markers that make a message sound friendly or cold.

| Typed | Pinyin | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 好的 / 收到 | hǎode / shōudào | OK / got it |
| 没事 / 不客气 | méishì / bú kèqi | no worries / you're welcome |
| 等一下 / 稍等 | děng yíxià / shāoděng | hang on / one moment |
| 马上 / 到了 | mǎshàng / dào le | right away / I'm here |
| 吗 呢 吧 啊 | ma ne ba a | question, 'and you?', suggestion, softener |
| 哈哈哈 / 笑死 | hāhāhā / xiàosǐ | LOL / I'm dying |
| 在吗? | zài ma | you there? |

**Number and letter shorthand** you'll also see: 666 (liùliùliù, "nice, well played"), 88 (bābā, bye-bye), 3Q (thank you), hhh (哈哈哈), yyds (永远的神, "the GOAT").

## Examples

- 在吗? zài ma: You there?
- 好的,明天见! hǎode, míngtiān jiàn: OK, see you tomorrow!
- 收到,谢谢! shōudào, xièxie: Got it, thanks!
- 等一下,我马上来。 děng yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng lái: Hang on, I'll be right there.
- 我到了,你在哪儿? wǒ dào le, nǐ zài nǎr: I'm here, where are you?
- 你到哪儿了? nǐ dào nǎr le: Where are you now?
- 我在路上了。 wǒ zài lùshang le: I'm on my way.
- 怎么了? zěnme le: What's up?
- 为什么不回我? wèishénme bù huí wǒ: Why aren't you replying?
- 不好意思,我来晚了。 bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ lái wǎn le: Sorry I'm late.
- 哈哈哈,笑死我了。 hāhāhā, xiào sǐ wǒ le: Hahaha, I'm dying.
- 早点睡,晚安! zǎo diǎn shuì, wǎn'ān: Get some sleep, good night!

## Common mistakes

- **Particles all have 口.** 吗 呢 吧 啊 哈 嗯 share the mouth radical, so read the right side: 马 mǎ, 尼 ní, 巴 bā, 阿 ā, 合 hé.
- **A bare 哦 or 嗯 can read as cold.** Doubling (嗯嗯, 好的好的) or adding 啊/呀 makes it warmer.

cards.Example: 好的,明天见! hǎode, míngtiān jiàn: OK, see you tomorrow!
cards.Notes: The standard 'OK' reply; also typed 好滴 or 好哒 to sound cute

cards.Example: 没事,别担心。 méishì, bié dānxīn: It's fine, don't worry.
cards.Notes: 没 = 氵 + 殳; often typed 没事儿 in the north

cards.Example: 怎么了? zěnme le: What's up? / What's wrong?
cards.Notes: 怎 = 乍 zhà + 心 heart

cards.Example: 你说什么? nǐ shuō shénme: What did you say?
cards.Notes: 什 = 亻 + 十 shí; jokingly typed 神马 (shénmǎ)

cards.Example: 为什么不回我? wèishénme bù huí wǒ: Why aren't you replying?
cards.Notes: 为 is wèi here; it's wéi in 以为

cards.Example: 哈哈哈,太好笑了! hāhāhā, tài hǎoxiào le: Hahaha, so funny!
cards.Notes: 口 + 合 hé; the more 哈, the harder the laugh; also typed hhh

cards.Example: 谢谢你啊! xièxie nǐ a: Thank you!
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 射 shè

cards.Example: 不客气,应该的。 bú kèqi, yīnggāi de: You're welcome, it's nothing.
cards.Notes: 不 is bú before the 4th-tone 客

cards.Example: 等一下,我马上来。 děng yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng lái: Hang on, I'll be right there.
cards.Notes: 等 = ⺮ bamboo + 寺 sì; 一 is yí before 下

cards.Example: 马上到! mǎshàng dào: Almost there!
cards.Notes: Literally 'on horseback'; 马上到 often means 'still ten minutes away'

cards.Example: 我到了,你在哪儿? wǒ dào le, nǐ zài nǎr: I'm here, where are you?
cards.Notes: 到 = 至 arrive + 刂 knife

cards.Example: 你吃了吗? nǐ chī le ma: Have you eaten?
cards.Notes: 口 + 马 mǎ for the sound

cards.Example: 我很好,你呢? wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne: I'm good, and you?
cards.Notes: 口 + 尼 ní for the sound

cards.Example: 走吧! zǒu ba: Let's go!
cards.Notes: 口 + 巴 bā; also in 酒吧 (jiǔbā, bar)

cards.Example: 好啊! hǎo a: Sure!
cards.Notes: 口 + 阿 ā; turns a flat 好 into an eager 'sure!'
The classic WeChat opener, usually followed by a favour

cards.Example: 收到,谢谢! shōudào, xièxie: Got it, thanks!
cards.Notes: The standard 'noted' in work and family group chats

cards.Example: 稍等,我看一下。 shāoděng, wǒ kàn yíxià: One sec, let me check.
cards.Notes: 稍 = 禾 + 肖 xiāo; compare 消 in 消息

cards.Example: 嗯嗯,好的。 ǹg ǹg, hǎode: Mm-hm, OK.
cards.Notes: Usually said 'en en'; doubled sounds warmer than a single 嗯

cards.Example: 早点睡,晚安! zǎo diǎn shuì, wǎn'ān: Get some sleep, good night!
cards.Notes: 安 = 宀 roof + 女

cards.Example: 我发语音给你。 wǒ fā yǔyīn gěi nǐ: I'll send you a voice message.
cards.Notes: 语 = 讠 speech + 吾 wú; 音 means sound

cards.Example: 发个红包吧! fā ge hóngbāo ba: Send a red envelope!
cards.Notes: 红 = 纟 silk + 工 gōng for the sound; 包 = bag

cards.Example: 不好意思,我来晚了。 bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ lái wǎn le: Sorry I'm late.
cards.Notes: 不 stays bù before the 3rd-tone 好

cards.Example: 看到消息回我一下。 kàndào xiāoxi huí wǒ yíxià: Reply when you see this.
cards.Notes: 消 = 氵 + 肖 xiāo; 息 = 自 + 心
Often shortened to 笑死; 笑 has ⺮ bamboo on top
Set reply when someone did a job for you; 辛 vs 幸 (xìng, lucky)
哪 (where) has 口; 那 (there) doesn't
路 = 足 foot + 各 gè
